'''Ord Biniir''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[File:Second_Battle_of_Ord_Biniir.jpg|thumb|left|The [[Second Battle of Ord Biniir|Battle of Ord Biniir]]]]

The planet originally was colonized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] circa [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], an influential [[General/Legends|general]] was hiring an individual to remove a few precarious objects from his personal estate.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Secret Vices}}</ref>

Ord Biniir was in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sha'a Gi]] hailed from this planet.<ref name="DB" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it became the site of the [[Second Battle of Ord Biniir|Battle of Ord Biniir]].<ref name="TEGtW-AC10" />

It was later conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="TEA" />
